model_annotation: The graph displays the loss values over the number of iterations for various models, including Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 0 to 140,000, while the y-axis shows the loss, which ranges from 2.4 to 3.4. All models exhibit a rapid decrease in loss during the initial iterations, followed by a gradual convergence. The Vanilla model starts with the highest loss and converges to a slightly higher loss compared to the other models. StrmLLM (n=64) and SepLLM (n=64) show similar trends, with SepLLM (n=64, H) and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) following closely. The SepLLM (n=128) model shows a slightly different trend, with a more gradual decrease in loss compared to the others. Overall, all models converge to a loss value around 2.5, with the SepLLM variants showing slightly better performance in terms of lower loss values.
